title: [Day 03] Full DOM snapshot with stable node ids and masking
text:
@cursor Part 5 of 5 for issue #3: Full DOM snapshot with stable node ids and masking.

Read AGENTS.md (sections Parts, QA and bug fixes, Commits), .cursor/rules (including 90-lessons.mdc) and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md first. Read the whole issue #3, then do ONLY Part 5.

Work test-first: first a test commit `test(recorder): take full DOM snapshot (#3)` with tests and stubs, then the implementation commit.

Prompt: Add `takeFullSnapshot(document, ctx)` that returns a `full_snapshot` event using `createEvent` from `@rewind/shared`. Put it in `packages/recorder/src/snapshot/`. Build on `serializeNode`, the `Mirror` and the privacy options from Parts 1 to 4; do not duplicate their logic. The event data is `{ node }` where `node` is the serialized Document node. The caller passes the `Clock` for `createEvent` through the context, or as a clearly named parameter; explain the choice in the PR note. Export `takeFullSnapshot` from `packages/recorder/src/index.ts` with a short TSDoc comment.

Requirements:
- Output passes `parseEvent` from `@rewind/shared`
- Snapshot of the same document twice, with the same `Mirror`, gives the same ids
- Every node in the output has a unique id
- Mark the PR as ready for review is NOT your job in this setup: leave the PR as a draft. The reviewer marks it ready after the final review.

Checks you must run before pushing:
- `pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build` pass
- Integration test on a realistic page fixture (header, form with a passwo
